objective: Verify failure semantics and robustness when handling noise, out-of-range keys, and invalid actions.
procedure: Inject a synthetic stream containing valid keystrokes interleaved with invalid actions and out-of-range VK codes.
Verify pipeline yields PARTIAL status and records individual failures without crashing.
Verify valid events continue to be normalized and analyzed.
limitations: Tests software-level input validation only; does not simulate hardware input corruption.
